title: Andy's Prawn & Chickpea Curry
ingredients: 1 onion, diced and 3 garlic cloves, minced
Spice Mix: 1 tbsp curry powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp turmeric
2 tbsp vegetable oil and 1 tsp salt
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat and sauté the diced onion until softened.
Add minced garlic, grated ginger, and the spice mix, stirring constantly for one minute until fragrant.
Pour in the canned chopped tomatoes and coconut milk, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Stir in the drained chickpeas and cook for ten minutes until the curry thickens slightly.
Add the prawns to the simmering skillet and cook for three to five minutes until pink and opaque.
